compiled_state.title: Add ticket-scratch.sh dispatcher routing dso ticket scratch verb
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
(None — infrastructure/glue task; DD ownership is implicit via tasks 2, 3, 4 which exercise the verbs through this dispatcher.)

## Description

Create plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-scratch.sh — a thin dispatcher that routes `dso ticket scratch <verb> [args...]` to ticket-scratch-set.sh / ticket-scratch-get.sh / ticket-scratch-clear.sh. Unknown verb returns a structured error envelope `{status:"error",code:"unknown_verb",verb:<v>}` with non-zero exit. Register the `scratch` subcommand in the dso ticket CLI router so the dispatcher resolves correctly.

## TDD Test Approach (Given/When/Then)

Given the dispatcher is wired into the dso ticket router; When `dso ticket scratch set` runs; Then it invokes ticket-scratch-set.sh and exits 0. Given an unknown verb; When `dso ticket scratch frobnicate` runs; Then exit code is non-zero AND stdout is `{status:"error",code:"unknown_verb",verb:"frobnicate"}`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: N/A (no format_check command configured)
- [ ] Dispatcher routes set/get/clear verbs to the correct per-verb script
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-scratch-set.sh
- [ ] Unknown verb returns structured error envelope with non-zero exit
  Verify: bash -c 'out=$(.claude/scripts/dso ticket scratch frobnicate test-001 2>&1); rc=$?; [ "$rc" -ne 0 ] && echo "$out" | grep -q unknown_verb'
- [ ] New dispatcher is executable
  Verify: test -x plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-scratch.sh

## File Impact

| Path | Action |
|------|--------|
| plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-scratch.sh | Create |

## Retry Budget

MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet to opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

Test results: all 4 scratch test files pass (102 assertions, 0 failures).
